resources.string: Stopped Sync. Photos already uploaded stay on Drive; the rest resume next time you sync.
Preparing %1$d of %2$d… (reading photo dates and locations)
No photos found in this date range.
Select at least one item first.
Sync failed. Check connection and sign-in.
No synced photos yet. Sync some photos first.
Sign in first to browse your Drive photos.
Couldn\'t load this photo from Drive.
Couldn\'t load photos from Drive. Check your connection and try again.
Long-press a photo to exclude it from uploading; long-press again to allow it.
Photo excluded — it will never be uploaded.
%1$d of the selected photos are already in your Drive folder. Upload them again anyway, or skip them?
All selected photos are already synced — nothing new to upload.
Paste the Google Drive folder link (or folder ID) that was shared with this account. This phone will sync into that folder instead of its own.
Now syncing into the shared folder.
Back to this account\'s own folder.
Couldn\'t find a folder ID in that link. Paste the full Drive folder link.
Sync complete — backed up %1$d photo(s), all with a location. None tagged NoGPS.
Sync complete — backed up %1$d photo(s), but %2$d had no GPS and none nearby to copy, so they\'re tagged NoGPS. Fix those on the Edit tab.
Sync complete — nothing new to back up.
\"%1$s\" link copied — paste it into a message or email.
Sign-in failed (code %1$d). Check the OAuth client setup in Google Cloud Console.
Drive account access wasn\'t granted — sync won\'t work until you allow it.
Not signed in — sign in on the Settings tab.

This forgets which photos have already been uploaded, so the next sync sends all of them again with corrected names and location data.

Delete the old photos from your Drive folder FIRST — otherwise you'll end up with two copies of everything.

Nothing on Drive is touched by this button.
Ready to re-upload. Now go to Sync → Sync Options → Sync All and start the sync.
Fix locations, or find redundant photos to delete.
Reading photos and working out locations…
Done — renamed %1$d photo(s), %2$d took the location of an earlier photo.
%1$d couldn\'t be changed (not uploaded by this app).
%1$d had GPS copied in from an earlier photo, so their Map links work now.
%1$d are still unlocated — they come before the first photo that has a location.
None of the %1$d photos on Drive has GPS to copy from, so there\'s nothing to inherit. Re-sync some photos (this build now uploads GPS correctly), or type a location in below.
No Drive folder loaded yet — sign in on the Settings tab, then reopen this tab.
Type a location first, e.g. \"France, Paris\".
Couldn\'t rename %1$s — Drive wouldn\'t allow it.
Asking AI which ones are redundant…
Compared %1$d photos. Tap Cancel to go back.
Only %1$d photo here — need at least two to compare.
Found %1$d group(s) of similar photos — %2$d selected to delete.
AI couldn\'t review this group — pick manually.
No photos ticked. Tick the box on a photo, then tap Delete.
%1$d of %2$d photos ticked. Tick any photo, then tap Delete — or Cancel to stop.
%1$d photo(s) will be moved to your Google Drive trash, where they can still be recovered for 30 days.
